Caught up with Emma, who is on holiday this week and returning to work on Monday. Spoke at length about planning a CV and the different sections. Her CV is quite long, so we discussed treating it as a master CV. She is sending it over for a review so she can work on updates next week while I am away. She needs support with interviews as she feels this is an area that lets her down. We discussed CAR stories, and she was already familiar with STAR stories. I also showed her a matrix that she can use to capture her thoughts in a structured way.
Emma is struggling somewhat with confidence, procrastination, and wanting things to be perfect. We discussed these challenges and ways to address them.

Caught up with Emma again and went through her CV. We discussed the key achievements section and that she does not necessarily need to categorize achievements if doing so is creating additional pressure. She feels she needs to choose the "correct" examples, which I explained may be contributing to unnecessary stress. We also discussed her low confidence and her difficulty putting herself forward. I suggested networking webinars that she could potentially attend.

At the last catch-up with Emma, she was feeling low, so we focused on confidence-building, visualization techniques, and wellbeing. She shared that the book I previously recommended had been helpful. I also mentioned a library app as a cost-free way to access books and resources. I encouraged her to reach out and keep me updated on her progress.
